name: io.github.Servosity/cove-mcp
title: Cove Data Protection MCP
description: Fleet-wide Cove Data Protection backup health, billing, and storage trends from your terminal.

environmentVariables.name: COVE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL for the Cove Data Protection API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

environmentVariables.name: COVE_PARTNER
environmentVariables.description: The full customer/partner string exactly as it appears in the Cove console dropdown, including the parenthesised email, e.g. 'Acme Corp (admin@example.com)'.

environmentVariables.name: COVE_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: API token issued with the Cove API user. Cove shows it once, at creation.

environmentVariables.name: COVE_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Login name of the Cove API user (Cove console: Settings > API users). This is the API user's login, not your console email.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional: binds the MCP server to an existing tenant-gated Printing Press client profile. Leave unset for a single-tenant install.

environmentVariables.name: COVE_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing execute call.

environmentVariables.name: COVE_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and the response cache is off.

environmentVariables.name: COVE_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http. Not needed for the default local stdio transport.

environmentVariables.name: COVE_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Cove requests.
